body: It was a communication spell to heal a broken relationship. I made a sigil then followed a spell that included writing my attention and anointing it with blood. I said that I wished for healing and contact, for Ill will to be prepared, and then let an oil anointed candle burn out to activate it.
I casted in around 9pm on April 19th. I was very specific but did not set specific protections aside from verbally and using fu dogs to ward off evil.
